video:video.video:description: The US Endoume 26/27 jersey kit by Kappa: the neighbourhood club founded in 1925, worn through the streets, beaches and creeks of Marseille, from Notre-Dame-de-la-Garde to the Vallon des Auffes.

video:video.video:description: The Mizuno × Vrunk collection in São Paulo with KYAN: sneakers, tracksuits and the city's alleys, cut to the rhythm of the street.

video:video.video:description: Motocross, drifting and CGI: the Mizuno × Vrunk collection staged with Ven1 among the towers of Nanterre, under a rain of petals.
